summary.en: Three days ago, Mutsumi Seino suddenly told her husband Daiichiro and her mother-in-law Ura that all of them should move away like what the Sasakis did that morning because Mrs.Sasaki told her that they were fleeing from their cursed house, which both Daiichiro and Ura laughed it off. The next night, Mutsumi told her husband that she was experiencing symptoms often seen in a cold–which she just put all the blame on the curse, and demanded everyone to move away before things could have gotten any worse. Daiichiro decided to peek at the house this morning since he was worried about his wife’s behavior. He is doing so when spotted by Conan and Kogoro, who then decide to take on the case when Daiichiro mentions the house is cursed.

victims.name: Kenji Murakumo
victims.causeOfDeath: Blunt force trauma on the back of his head
